text:
maria: Heads-up — seeing a spike where requests that don't include `X-Embed-Dims` are getting routed to the slowpath and incurring ~3x cost. Affects multiple tenants, started ~1h ago :eyes: https://logs.internal/replay/abc123

sam: Can you paste a repro request + logs? we should confirm if preflight is explicitly failing or choosing conservative route.

maria: quick repro below — notice missing dims header: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model":"open-embedding-v1","input":["{\"user\":\"hi\"}"]}'
```

maria: logs: 
```
preflight: parsing payload -> items=1, sample_len=36
preflight: inferred_dims=null
routing: chosen=slowpath reason="dims_unknown"
quota: estimated_units=48 actual_units=162
```

pj: hm — looks like the detector bails when the item looks like JSON (starts with "{"). I thought we had a fallback that counts tokens to pick dims for single-string arrays?

maria: same — earlier heuristic inferred dims for plain text arrays but returns null for JSON-y strings. Tenants sending serialized JSON blobs (analytics events) trigger this.

alex: Console impact: these requests show up as unexpectedly high unit usage and blow past soft quotas. We should expose a console hint: "inferred dims used" and a link to best practices.

pj: proposal: attempt inference for single-item arrays when item_size < 2048 bytes and the string doesn't parse as JSON OR if parse succeeds, check for a "text"-like key. If ambiguous, mark "inferred=false" and route slowpath.

sam: rollout plan idea: implement a guarded inference path behind flag `preflight_infer_dims`. Default OFF. Canary to 5% tenants -> monitor preflight.infer_attempts, preflight.inferred_true, preflight.inferred_false, and route.latency/cost deltas.

dev-bot: Alert — preflight_infer_attempts for route=embeddings spiked +420% in last 60m.

pj: telemetry: add boolean tag `preflight.inferred` on request traces, emit `preflight_infer_reason` (e.g., "single_item_small_text", "json_ambiguous"). Add histogram of estimated_units vs actual_units.

alex: UI work: add a small badge in the per-route cost breakdown "inferred dims" which links to the raw request sample (redact). Also a console notification when a tenant hits >2x estimated_units due to slowpath.

maria: mitigation: we'll also push a tiny patch to client SDKs to set `X-Embed-Dims` when inputs are plain text arrays. I'll open PR.

sam: I'll own the server change + feature flag. Can we gate inference to not run for requests > 10k chars? keep cheap checks only. We'll enable canary Monday morning (after weekend freeze?). :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Created INF-2891 "preflight: inference for ambiguous JSON strings causing slowpath routing" assigned to @sam and @pj. Added task for console hint and telemetry dashboard tile.

alex: ping me when the telemetry emits so I can add the dashboard card (prefetch a histogram for estimated vs billed units).

maria: Thanks — also leaving a short note in #docs to tell customers to prefer explicit dims header for serialized payloads.

sam: plan: implement, smoke test, enable 5% canary, monitor for 48h. If error rate or overbilling drops -> expand. If regressions, flip flag off.

pj: sounds good. low-risk and gives better UX. We'll also add one-off alert to catch when inferred=true but actual_units > estimated_units * 2.

maria: great, filing a small checklist in the ticket and adding links to the logs and sample payloads. Thanks y'all.
